description: This file defines the SugarFieldAddress class, which extends SugarFieldBase. It handles rendering of address fields for detail and edit views within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including fetching templates, handling display parameters, and error logging.

classes.name: SugarFieldAddress
classes.description: A class that manages the display and rendering of address fields in various views within the CRM, including handling templates and configuration parameters.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and returns the template for displaying address details in the detail view, using provided display parameters and handling errors if necessary.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and returns the template for editing address fields, with support for override templates and error handling.
